annotations.title: Secure link for tokens and the app catalog

description: Returns a one-time link to a page on this server where the owner types the Cloudflare token, the R2 keys and the source app's Data API token, and can upload the editor catalog file. They are checked, sealed in the job and never pass through the chat. Use it instead of putting tokens in tool calls. Give app_base_url (and version) for a new job, or job_id to add tokens to an existing one. The link works for 30 minutes. Free.

app_base_url.description: The source app's address, for a new job.

job_id.description: An existing job, to add or replace its tokens.

name: nc_connect
